# Babelize Elements

Open-source Localization UI components for React and Tailwind CSS.

## Features

- Language switchers, locale pickers, RTL layouts
- Install via npm — `npm install @babelize/elements`
- Install components individually — `npx shadcn@latest add @elements/<component>`
- TypeScript-first, accessible, MIT-licensed
- Works with next-intl, react-i18next, react-intl, and more

## Quick Start

```bash
npm install @babelize/elements
```

Or install a single component (register the registry once):

```bash
npx shadcn@latest registry add @elements=https://elements.babelize.co/r/{name}.json
npx shadcn@latest add @elements/language-switcher
```

```tsx
import { LanguageSwitcher } from "@/components/ui/language-switcher";
// or, with the full library:
// import { LanguageSwitcher } from "@babelize/elements";

export function App() {
  return (
    <LanguageSwitcher
      locales={[
        { code: "en", label: "English" },
        { code: "fr", label: "Français" },
      ]}
      onLocaleChange={(code) => console.log(code)}
    />
  );
}
```
